key_exclusions: competitor list limited to selected retailers
policy_text_full: Macy's offers a 10-day price adjustment for own price drops and from selected competitors. Doorbusters, Specials, and Last Act clearance items are excluded. Refund is issued to original tender.
policy_text_relevant_clause: Within 10 days of purchase, customers can submit a price adjustment request; doorbusters, Specials, and Last Act items are excluded.
